name: Hall Reverse-Mutation Corner-Elimination Neighbor
definition: The twelve-coordinate family $(C_H\setminus\{2\})\cup\{2049\}$, where $C_H$ is the database-owned 299-concept Hall maximum class and integers use the standard binary-word encoding.
properties: It is maximum of VC dimension three and has exactly the two corners 1026 and 2050, at Hamming distance two. The reverse legal exchange removes the degree-four word 2049 and restores 2, returning to the cornerless Hall class without creating a corner.
